subject: general
question: Kumudini Lakhia, the founder of Kadamb School of Dance and Music, is a _______ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kumudini Lakhia is an** Indian Kathak dancer and choreographer** based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
 
• She **founded Kadamb School of Dance and Music**, an institute of Indian dance music in 1967.
 
• She started her career dancing with** Ram Gopal**.​​ 
 
• Bharatanatyam, Kathakali, Manipuri, Kuchipudi, and Odissi are among the** major Indian classical dance-dramas**, along with Kathak.
 
• Native to northern India, Kathak was **shaped by both Muslim and Hindu cultural influences.**
 
• One of the eight primary styles of Indian classical dance is Kathak. It is the** traditional dance of Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The origins of Kathak are frequently attributed to the travelling storytellers or bards known as **Kathakars** in ancient northern India. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kumudini learned first from various gurus of **Jaipur Gharana**, and then from** Shambhu Maharaj**.
 
• Kumudini was the name of the mother of Rai Bahadur Ranada Prasad Shaha.
 
• The world-famous Kathak dancer, **Pandit Birju Maharaj is the face of the Kalka-Bindadin Gharana** of Lucknow.
